d: America’s MQ-9 Reaper drones are facing growing losses over Iran, with Tehran claiming to have brought down its 55th aircraft. In this video, Firstpost examines why these expensive drones, designed for long-endurance surveillance and precision strikes, are proving vulnerable to Iranian air defences and electronic warfare. Each Reaper costs up to $50 million and can carry Hellfire missiles, but it has no dedicated defence against incoming missiles or fighter aircraft.
